fields.publicationTitle: USD/INR — Reference Rate History and Source Methodology
fields.useCasePaymentCategory: FX Intelligence; Cross-Border Payments; Treasury and Liquidity
fields.executiveSummary: GPIR preserves 218 dated USD/INR reference observations from 2 January 2026 through 6 November 2026. Within that verified window, stored rates ranged from 89.852362 to 96.825 INR per USD; the first observation was 90.196229 and the latest was 94.537031. The archive lineage combines Frankfurter's ECB-backed dated series with the existing reference-open-er-api capture path. Stored methods for this pair are derived-cross and provider-native. Cross rates are derived only from same-date source observations. These values are reference observations, not executable quotes, remittance prices or recommendations. The evidence does not establish a market cause, policy effect or forecast; execution time, spreads, fees, liquidity and settlement terms are outside this publication.
